name: Sunstone Resort & Arena
description: Welcome to Sunstone Luxury Resort & Arena. Nestled along the scenic coastline of Kovalam, Sunstone offers an idyllic retreat blending beachside luxury with sports hospitality. Featuring private plunge pool villas, panoramic ocean-view suites, an infinity pool, multi-cuisine open-air dining, and world-class turf facilities, we provide unforgettable stays for families, couples, and leisure travelers.
address: 142 East Coast Road, Kovalam Beach Road, Near Covelong Point

policies: Valid Government Photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport / DL) required at check-in for all adults.
Couples and families are warmly welcomed. Primary guest must be 18+ years of age.
Smoking strictly prohibited inside bedrooms; designated outdoor open-air zones available.
Early check-in and late check-out subject to villa availability upon prior request.

highlights.title: Great breakfast & inclusions
highlights.description: Breakfast buffet gets strong praise for its wide spread, varied choices, and fresh multi-cuisine preparations.

highlights.title: Great food & dining
highlights.description: In-house multi-cuisine dining options with seafood specialties and room service options praised by guests.

highlights.title: Professional guest services
highlights.description: Dedicated 24/7 front desk, warm concierge, express check-in, and personalized butler assistance.

highlights.title: Sparkling clean & hygienic
highlights.description: Rooms are regularly sanitized and described as clean, neat, and well kept with spotless linen.

highlights.title: Top property leisure facilities
highlights.description: Private swimming pool, lawn garden, sun deck, and entertainment conveniences designed for staycations.
